bullets.bullet_text: Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs for regulated financial institutions, establishing traceable scenario architectures, challenger models, and model-risk remediation frameworks that underpinned enterprise governance and audit readiness.

Led quantitative derivatives and variable-annuity hedging design for insurance capital adequacy, applying exotic pricing, liability Greek stress-testing, and hedge architecture to strengthen solvency and reserving positions.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, establishing three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata governance standards, and auditable risk-data aggregation metrics across the organization.
